description:
During our sunset or day sailing cruise you will participate in a unique sailing experience. You will enjoy 2 hours of sailing, leaving and returning from Barcelonas beautiful Port Olimpic. We will sail out 3 to 4 miles and then tack back to sail against the skyline of Barcelona. During our cruise you will enjoy free catalan cava. You can actively participate in the sailing event or just be carried along enjoying the cruise.

We leave from Barcelona Port Olimpic. Meeting point is at the Moll de la Marina 3. Once we leave the port we set the main sail and genoa sail and start sailing towards the November Buoy. There we tack and sail back enjoying the views.

During our event you can get to learn the basic sailing procedures, enjoy a relaxing open air activity and have excellent and unique views of Barcelona. If the weather is nice you can also take a swim in the med.

Sometimes we are lucky enough to see Dolphins or Tuna jumping out of the water. This experience is a great way to see Barcelona from another perspective.
locationDescription:
Port Olimpic Barcelona is the port with te most recreational movements in Spain. It was built specifically for the 1992 Summer Olimpics.

During our cruise we will enjoy the Barcelona Skyline with excellent views of the Diaginal Mar, Forum, Montjuic, Hotel W and Tibidabo.

reviews.text: Nice way to start our trip. We saw dolphins! Our skipper provided snacks and some champagne. We did get a little sea sick because we were super jet lagged but other than that, it was great!

Luis made our time in Barcelona unforgettable!!!! He was such a good host taking us to see the best sunset view and also telling all the good stories about the city and about him and his boat. He served us good drinks and some snacks as well. We loved it very very very much and will definitely come back next time!
This was an amazing tour that I highly recommend! Luis makes sure everyone is having a good time and you get to see beautiful sights.

Luis is a professional, friendly and special person. The description of the event was acurate, and the whole experince was outstanding and worth trying.
I enjoyed the skyline of Barcelona, got to know more about the city and met nice people.

A wonderful experience! Luis is a natural storyteller, funny, and a great professional sailer. We talked about Barcelona and its history, sailing, and so much more. The trip was smooth, the fresh wind and the sunset were breathtaking!

It was nice to get away from the busy city vibes for a couple of hours. We were lucky to have great weather with low waves, and to top it off, had a nice group! Highly recommended.

The trip was very nice and a great experience. Luis told us a lot about Barcelona and sailing. We were also provided with snacks. The view of the city and the sunset was of course also great. We had a very good time and can definitely recommend the sailing trip!

It was a really nice activity to do here in Barcelona, especially because it’s something different. Did it in the evening, so the sunset was perfect :) Nice to do as a couple, with friends but also alone.

The sunset tour was a great experience. Luis is a very friendly host, drinks and snacks on board were provided. We chatted with Luis and the other on board on a friendly level, which made the 2.5 hours very nice.
We had a really great time. Luis is an interesting person with a lot of knowledge, he knows 7 languages and is very relatable to most people. The tour was very informative along with relaxing.

This was an exceptional experience, Luis was an amazing host. He let me take control of the wheel of the ship and provided us with an unforgettable evening.

I recommend everyone to take part in this experience and hope they'll enjoy it as much as I did.
We had a great time sailing with Adria! He was very pleasant and made conversation easy. It was a fun relaxing evening. Highly recommend!!

We recommend that you do it at sunset time. The view from the yacht at sunset and the view of Barcelona Beach were so nice.
The host was so kind and explained well, so I had a great time. However, we suffered from a fever because our preparation was inadequate.
If you're planning a yacht tour, etc., it would be much better if you prepared a medicine!
We had an amazing experience and I recommend everyone. It's a great way to discover the city and also sailing. Luis is also an amazing person and a great host !

I have been wanting to make it on a relaxing boat ride and this tour with Luis was exactly that! We sailed away from the harbor and he taught us a bit about how to sail. Then by sunset we turned around and sailed directly toward the sunset. Gorgeous views all around and interesting stories about Barcelona and his background. Definitely recommend!

Gabriel is very professional. The weather was not perfect for sunset but he made sure everything was safe and under control for a windy day. We spent more than 2 hours and it was an unique experience.

Two of us participated in the lunch or day trip and enjoyed it very much. We are sailed with Adriatic Sea and in addition to a very nice trip with a little wind, it was also very entertaining with him. The weather was not perfect, but there was no impact on the trip.

Such an amazing way to end our trip to Barcelona! Big thanks to Gabriel for being such an amazing host, proving snacks, drinks and just making sure we had a great time. I would %100 recommend to anyone in Barcelona!!

The trip with Luis was everything we were hoping for and more! We chose the experience as a birthday gift for a friend and it was the perfect day. Luis was super helpful about everything, he provided snacks and drinks for us and told us interesting stories about himself and Barcelona. I highly recommend this experience to anyone here visiting or living in Barcelona looking for a fun activity with friends.

It's an amazing experience we had with Luis. She was on time and easy to meet. She was very friendly and explained everything we were seeing as we went. She is part of the helm control to the crew and shared a lot of curious data about the port and its surroundings. She shared snacks and drinks with us. She always cared about our comfort and safety. A crew member felt very bad about nausea and vomit, and Luis was excellent in giving them what they needed to take care of her.
An unforgettable experience, we were the only ones we booked, a group trip became a private one. We chatted, we learned, we met, the truth was we thought it was excellent!

Luis was such a great host! We had a lovely time on his boat, sharing stories, meeting great people from around the world, and dipping into the water. One of our favorite memories from our trip to Barcelona was this tour. Thank you, Luis!

A wonderful experience that i did on my last day in Barcelona and is totally recommended to everyone visiting Barcelona, it was so refreshing seeing Barcelona from a different view point and taking a dip in the ocean was so refreshing, luis was great, nice , has thorough information about Barcelona and its history and i learned alot and had a great time. Tbh wish i did this much earlier in my trip.

My fiancée and I had so much fun on this sailing experience. Luis was absolutely amazing, very safe and knew a lot about the history of the area. He also brought some delicious snacks and drinks - Loved the Cava! Will definitely be booking again next time we’re in Barcelona and would recommend it to anyone visiting

I thoroughly enjoyed taking a dip in the warm med waters of august. Gabriel provided us with drinks and was very accommodating with guests who felt seasick. If you are looking for a chill laidback experience I recommend this.

Totally recommended. Luis is an aesthetic history, accommodating, friendly, fun and goes the extra mile for the guests.
Thank you very much for being a part of the whole group!
Nice trip with a great view of Barcelona in the evening mood. The sunset was, of course, the highlight. We were well taken care of on board 🥂 and there were very nice encounters and conversations. 😊

Our sailing Captain was Gabriel. He was very easy going and it was fun to watch him navigate such a big boat. Gabriel navigated us to a good spot, we jumped into the Mediterranean for a while and then made our way back. We enjoyed cold beers and Gabriel’s stories of how he became a sailor. He gave us some good restaurant recommendations as well! Honestly this tour is worth it (even if there was a group and not just us) and definitely a unique thing to do in Barcelona. We’ll be back and would love to do this again with some friends.

Please book this experience. My fiancé and I were on the fence and we decided to just go for it. There are few things as beautiful as a sunset over Barcelona out on the water. Gabriel took us out, let us swim and dive off the boat, take amazing photos, and continued supplying us with drinks and snacks. He was unbelievably accommodating and I would absolutely recommend this experience.

Great outing! Gabriel was our skipper. Beer, canva, and some pretzels. It felt like we were out on the water with a friend. Very cool, a little "fresh". We talked a little bit about barcelona, boating, and rock n roll.

We were with another French-speaking couple with whom the feeling went great.
It's a different way to see Barcelona at night.

Great welcome. Excellent language switch.
Nothing to say.
Treat yourself for a nice ride out 9f thz city.
Gabriel is a great host. Simple and generous with culture and refreshments.

We had a great experience. Gabriel was able to tell us a lot about our surroundings on the water and all the boats but also about Barcelona itself. He made sure we were feeling well and was able to do a different route when we started to feel a bit sick. It was really great to see Barcelona from the sea and we had a great time!

Everything was OK
We have already been to similar experiences and it was much more better than this one
No communication with guests and very limited drinks suggested

Luis is a very likeable person.
He shared his knowledge of Barcelona and seafaring with us.
I'd love to come back!
Best regards Andrea

The host is very friendly. But my experience was terrible, as the trip was very unstable and the waves very strong, so I ended up throwing up for the whole 3 hours. I had never gotten sick before when on a boat trip. At the beginning I thought it was only me who had a problem, but 4/8 people ended up throwing up and feeling sick during the trip. There was absolutely no warning before, it would have been great to receive a note to take some pills before, or to know that you could get sick. I have take other boat trips in Barcelona and elsewhere, this is the first time it happened. It is not the fault of the host, but at least there should be a warning. The money value was way too much for having such a bad experience and didn't receive any money back. It took 30 mins after landing to start feeling better again, it was really too much.

An amazing experience, would recommend to everyone! Gabriel was super friendly and answered all our sailing questions. We swam in the sea, it was an unforgettable evening. Even though it was cloudy, we still saw incredible views. It did get a bit windy towards the end but felt safe the whole time.
10/10 sailing experience and we learnt so much about the area we were sailing as well! Luis was a gem, we look forward to our next trip / sailing experience with him.
This was a perfect trip! Very cool host, we could walk around the boat, chill, use the SUP-board and go for a long swim. All in all it was 10/10 and beyond, and we would love to come back!
Luis was ready to find a suitable time for our private trip which we really enjoyed and had much fun! Drinks, interesting facts about Barcelona and lots of fun is guaranteed!

I had a wonderful time on the boat! It is a great way to see the city from another side and feel the freedom of being on the water. Also the host was very kind and told us some nice stories.
I would really recommend this trip to do something different when visiting Barcelona!
Was a fantastic experience and would definitely recommend it to anyone who is looking to do something unique during their stay in Barcelona.

This was perhaps the biggest highlight of my trip in Barcelona! It was very good and the hosts were very welcoming and super friendly. Highly recommend for anyone wishing to experience sailing along the Barcelona coastline.
A great experience and a way to beat the heat. wonderful views of the barcelona skyline, endless cava and a wonderful host! Highly recommended for an evening activity and well worth the price!
Wonderful experience. Barcelona from a different perspective. Gabriel was wonderful about telling stories about the city and interesting facts.

Gabriel, our host, although experienced, seem to struggle a bit with the boat which wasn’t his. Overall , however, he tried hard to make everyone comfortable and was helpful when some of us started getting seasick. The sunset and Barcelona skyline were enjoyable despite the haze. On the other hand, the 14 yo that I had with me on the trip enjoyed it thoroughly and got to help with the sailing.

The sailing trip was great. The guide was really nice and took us for a relaxing tour. They offered us drinks often, made us feel at home and even adapted the tour to accommodate more water time.
Thank you!!!
I highly recommend this trip. Jero was very knowledgeable and took the time to explain the basics of sailing since we were curious and it was a great experience.

Luis is a very professional and experience sailor. He has many knowledge about sailing itself, boat, and of course the history about Barcelona historical sites, and cool places to hangout while our sailing.
He provided also the olives and snacks and best sangria in Barcelona.
Also he taught my boyfriend to learn sailing and to control wind.
A great value to have the sailing experience while visiting Barcelona.

It was a very nice experience and people were very friendly, everyone shared stories and got to know each other. Luis has a great energy, very welcoming and kind. I got seasick and everyone looked after me, it was heartwarming.

We booked the trip as a private party of 8 and had so much fun! The boat is gorgeous with plenty of places to sit and relax, we had the option to learn about sailing and steering the boat which was great fun! Also the complimentary drinks were lovely! Spent the evening enjoying the views and sunset over Barcelona. Amazing coming and Luis was a brilliant host, would definitely recommend and highlight of our holiday!

Super nice boat tour at sunset!

wonderful sunset cruise with great people. Everything was straightforward, snacks and drinks were provided and Luis was a very friendly host. sights were explained, you could also move freely on the boat. great ending of our vacation! Thank you

An absolutely recommended tour and definitely a highlight of our Barcelona vacation! Luis is super caring and we were well supplied with snacks, drinks and an extra jacket. You feel completely safe and in good hands.
Would highly recommend this event, had a great time with Luis. Had fun conversations and learnt about how to sail. Also very generous with the drinks and snacks.
Definitely a must-do in Barcelona! We had a fantastic time with Luis and I would highly recommend his tour. It was a lot of fun and we learned a lot about sailing.

I experienced a magical evening on the cruise. Luis is very knowledgeable, warm, welcoming and prioritised our safety above anything else. He also offered a range of snacks and drinks for us. He made the experience very personal and memorable for the whole group. I can’t wait to go sailing with Luis again!
Amazing sailing trip! A new way to see Barcelona! We loved how Luis specialized the trip with alcohol and snacks. Very thoughtful! Highly recommend his expertise and personality!

I have lived in Barcelona for almost 2 years and I have never been on a boat in the city before. When I tell you this experience should be at the top of your Barcelona bucket list, believe me!! We felt safe and cared for the entire time, and Luis was just a really wonderful sailor and guide. Cannot say enough good things. I will be recommending this experience to everyone! Thank you Luis!!! <3

What an awesome evening with Luis and the other guests! He suggested we started off with a little introduction round and that really broke the ice. I was traveling alone but quickly everyone was talking. We enjoyed each others company and he let us help if we wanted to. I stood behind the helm for a good 20min! Great experience on a beautiful boat with a super host.

I am very scared of water and I can’t swim, so that has always stopped me from going out to sea or lakes on a boat. But looking at the opportunity here I decided embrace my fears and go for it.

And I am so thankful and happy I decided to do it! Sebastian, our skipper, and the whole group was so fun as well as understanding about my fears. They helped a lot to enjoy the experience.

Sebastian is a master skipper! He even guided the group to basics of sailing. The views were out of this world and pictures can’t do justice to it. The sunset and the Mediterranean took my breath away.

Good food, good weather, good vibes and good company.. couldn’t ask for more.. Highly recommend, once in a lifetime !

A real sailing experience! The evening was perfect. The sunset was romantic! Luis was very accommodating with blankets and coats…..and he also taught us history about Barcelona along the way. I highly recommend this tour for anyone who wants to see Barcelona from a different viewpoint. Ask for Luis!

Luis is an amazing captain and host. We were the only ones that booked for the afternoon time, but he was great company and very generous with drinks and the snacks! The views were beautiful and though it was a bit windy, he had blankets on deck to make sure we were comfortable. I definitely plan to book a sail with Luis again in the future when I return to Barcelona!

The trip was definitely one of my highlights in Barcelona. Luis is a great host: attentive, passionate, helpful and funny. He always asked if I needed anything and answered every question with joy. An amazing and unforgettable experience!

Luis is a great host, the experience was really amazing. Got a super view of Barcelona.
If you have a special requirements Luis is very helpful like that (he collected cake for us and plus we got to cut in on the boat)

Luis assisted me on the boat, and we set sail. Luis warned that at least 1/20 people get sea sick. The water was beautiful and calming. Then, some time into the trip, I became that chosen one. I informed Luis I was feeling nauseous. He immediately gave me a bag for preparation, and thank God he did. Through multiple bouts of vomiting, spitting, and nose running, Luis was very gracious, kind, and caring towards me. He provided we with endless bags to accommodate said vomit and even provided dry and wet tissue options during my up chucking. Despite, it was an amazing sunset. Great stories from Luis, and he’s a very smart guy! Definitely bring a jacket, but if not, he has blankets for you too! I would do it again, if I can ensure the vomiting remains on land, of course. Great Experience!

Luis was absolutely amazing! This is an absolute must for a Barcelona itinerary. He was so accommodating, funny, personable, and hospitable. He even helped my sister when she got seasick. It was so fun and comfortable and the time we spent out there didn’t feel like enough. Would recommend this to anyone!

This experience was one of the best memory of my life! ❤️
Thanks a lot Luis for your welcoming and your joy! Your shared with us a lot interesting informations about Barcelona and around!
If I come back to Barcelona I'll do this little trip again with Luis!

The trip was amazing, really enjoyed everything single moment of it. What made it so special is the host himself Luis , so kind, joyful sprit and knows how to make everyone happy. definitely I urge everyone to try this experience specially with this gentleman 🙏🏻

Wonderful experience, we had a lovely time! Lots of lovely touches, and felt very safe at sea! Beautiful sunset, and lovely friendly host. We loved this experience and would highly recommend for anyone who loves getting out on the water!

This was the highlight of my Barcelona Trip, totally recommend this!

As I was the only person who booked this experience on monday, I got to know Luis, the boat and the beautifulness of sailing. I did not have
much experience in sailing but Luis explained everything what I needed to know about sails, winds, the gear and he even let me hold the steering wheel so that I can adjust the direction in order to utilise the wind in the most efficient way.

Steering the boat, driving back to the coast and into the sunset was probably one of the greatest and most relaxing moments. If you are in barcelona you need to book this experience as this is also a total bargain as you will have 2.5h of fun.
Perfect program, great host! We could even sail ourselves! If you are looking for a memorable experience and a beautiful sunset, this is the best place for you!

I booked this experience for my girlfriend’s birthday and it exceeded my expectations! Luis is a great host, teacher, and conversationalist. Luckily, we had ideal conditions for sailing. He let us try a few basic sailing maneuvers if we were comfortable doing so. He would check in from time to time to see if we were thirsty and comfortable. My girlfriend loved the gift!

Luis is at the same time super professional with endless experience, so that you can feel absolutely safe - and he is also a great host who makes everyone feel at comfortable and he's good at entertaining his guests - even if you should wish to talk politics on the way back. (no need to) 🙂
Luis is a really great host and friendly. I AM HIGHLY RECOMMENDED PEOPLE TO COME HERE. This is such an amazing experience where I have met many new friends and beautiful ocean view of Barcelona❤️💙
Absolutely magical. We had booked the trip spontaneously and ended up driving out for two. Luis is an absolutely perfect host and made the trip so unique.
that is the experience i would highly recommend!!! amazing host, boat and city views, great conversations, Luis let me sail under his supervision, everything was perfect!

We were very luck to have the whole experience to ourselves. Luis was incredibly friendly and welcoming. His hospitality was fantastic. It was great to know a little about what he was doing in regards to the boat as we were sailing out and my fiancé even got the opportunity to steer (he’s sailed before and this extra personalised little experience put a big smile on his face). Luis was able to answer any questions we had re Barcelona and was able to point out dolphins and a tuna as we got out to sea. Watching the sunset was magical and we had the most incredible time. Definitely a massive highlight of our trip to Barcelona. We would highly recommend to anyone visiting.

This little private ride on Luis' boat was a once in a lifetime experience. We were able to admire a magnificent sunset. An activity that is both romantic and convivial. Thanks again to Luis for his sympathy and his welcome.

Luis is a super nice host! We felt very comfortable and safe with him on board. The time went so wonderful: great conversation, amazing views, real sailing experience and learning new terms, nice drinks and beautiful yacht. It was like a nice time spent with a friend, Luis is a great person to talk with and to sail with.
Also, Luis was a wonderful and caring as a host making sure me and my wife enjoy the experience.
I have no doubts that I would loved the tour even if it were six people, the atmosphere would be also great because of the host.

Definitely recommend this one and looking forward to sail again with Luis!
My sister and I really enjoyed the trip with Louis! We had beautiful weather, views, and company. Would highly recommend this experience to anyone else visiting Barcelona :)

Amazing! Such a wonderful time on a gorgeous yacht sailing into the sunset. Luis was a wonderful and caring host making sure everyone is enjoying their experience. Can’t wait to sail again on my next visit to Barcelona. Don’t think twice - book this experience especially if you enjoy being on the water.
Super sunset. Super hosts and really a nice experience! Nice wellness, good wind. Perfect for me, my girlfriend was more fun than I expected. Thanks Luis see you soon
Awesome experience. Luis took us in to the Mediterranean until we got a beautiful view of the land. Coming back we had an awesome view of everything in the setting sun. Highly recommended.

Amazing experience with a great host! The communication with Luis (our captain) was perfect! He explained every single detail to the group of six. From safety to how to take charge of the sailboat. Luis was welcoming, friendly, and caring especially with other passengers' seasickness issues. This will be a lovely opportunity to get out of Barcelona and see the city coastline from a different point of view.

PS. Looking forward to our trip to Greece or Ibiza Luis!

We had Luis sailing with us and it was such a beautiful experience. From the many stories he told us and his love for Barcelona. There were plenty of drinks to go around the group and hand sanitisers to keep everything safe. The views from the sea were astonishing and we had a super friendly group. Luis allowed us the opportunity to swim and also take the steering wheel and try our hand at sailing. All in all a great experience

I went on an evening trip with Luis who was great, the views were amazing and boat was nice. My wife got seasick halfway through and Luis was great about that straight away offering advice & a bag just in case! We had a really great time and loved seeing Barcelona from the sea.
A great time with Luis ! We loved sailing the coast of Barcelona at sunset. Recommended

I have to say the Sebastian was a great host ⭐️⭐️⭐️⭐️⭐️ He was communicating with every single one of the group. He was friendly, hospitable, and caring specially with my sea sickness issue. A big thanks go to the 3 ppl who were with me in the group, they were kind and compassionate 🌸🌸
Thank you so much for this getaway, it was very interesting, we talked and learned a lot. I recommend it to everything you want to feel free, it was a long parade of joy 👌🏻👌🏻

Our (Hidden by Airbnb) r Roman was great. Her experience, her personality, her master of sailing made our trip a unique moment.
The skyline of Barcelona, sea view, at the time of sunset is a must !
🙏 thank you...
We will come back !

Great experience to enjoy Barcelona in a different way! We leave the harbor under the sun and can swim in the open sea, then enjoy a magnificent sunset and admire the city skyline. Despite a rather rowdy sea during our experience we recommend it 100%! Great value with a professional and welcoming host.

Sebastian was our captain on the sunset sailing cruise out of Barcelona. He was very personable and most importantly knowledgeable in regards to the boat and the water and sailing. I felt safe at all times while on the cruise. It was an amazing and beautiful experience!!!

Great experience with great host. Luis has wonderful communicator and made all guests feel like home and family. Unfortunately, I had bad sea sickness and couldn’t see sunset because of that, but I was taking good nap in the warm & comfy couch in the boat. I look forward to my next trip

This experience was good. They allowed me to book last minute on my birthday after closing reservations. I had a hard time finding the boat and the skipper. Our group didn't really mesh, so it was silent almost the whole time which made it feel long. Fine experience for the first time I've been on a sailboat.

If it wasn't for the bad weather all of a sudden, it was the best.
It was the best experience at the moment. Thanks to the host, I went out comfortably. What I give here is just a little bit of a treat for Kava and water olives, so I recommend bringing other drinks, liquor, or snacks!

100% recommend- we enojoyed this experience so much, at first the warm sun then the amazining sunset and the city lights at night. being on a sailing boat gives you a completely different feeling of freedom. Our sailing guide and host Sebastian was awsome and we love the memories we made. Totally worth it!
Great trip to see a unique side of Barcelona. Was beautiful when the sun went down and we took a trip through the harbor as the lights of the city came to life.

Thank you for a great experience! Starting with enjoying the warmth of the sun, then the red skies of the sunset and finishing with admiring the lights of Barcelona in the dark made the whole trip magic! Hope to see you again soon!

Sebastian was a wondeful host! He shared great stories about his experience and made me feel safe. Loved the additional food and drink. Would recommend to anyone wanting to have a nice departing journey before leaving Barcelona
Great fun and the hosts were knowledgeable and passionate about their work. Overall a fun and beautiful way to experience the other view of Barcelona.

With the sunset in the background, you can see the city of Barcelona from the sea. Please experience it.Then, you can watch luxury cruisers sitting in the harbor of Barcelona and watching a movie.They don't have a place to park nearby, and they come to this port.
It was a dream space.
It gets cold, so don't forget to prepare for the cold!

Really awesome! I felt safe during the trip and you had everything that you need. Sebastian is very talkative and he knows everything about sailing. I can highly recommend it! Thanks a lot for an unforgettable experience!

We had a wonderful time on the cruise! It was easy to get to, beautiful & we felt comfortable on the boat. It is so peaceful out on the water, a great getaway from the city for a few hours. Perfect way to watch the first sunset of 2020!

Arrived late because we didn’t realize how far Barceloneta was from the port. But Sebastion was super understanding and got us onto the water right away once we got there. He later on handed me the whole bottle of wine to drink for me, my friend and one other person who was there with us on the boat. He said he had been sailing for quite a long time and even had pictures to share on his (Hidden by Airbnb) !
Definitely recommend going out on the Mediterranean if you haven’t!

This was the perfect way to sail into my birthday! The sunset was beautiful, the people were nice and we all got along, and Sebastian was very informative and caring. He even brought out blankets when it got a bit chilly for us. I highly recommend if you want to experience the water while in Barcelona ✨

The experience was super awesome. Even though most of us were only there for the view, Sebastian shared his knowledge and passion for sailing. He taught the basics of steering for those who are willing to learn.

A wonderful trip for a unique view of Barcelona. Luis spoilt us with drinks, olives and nuts and I even got to steer the boat back into the harbour. A great way to spend my last evening in Spain. And we were lucky to have a perfect sunset!

Luis was great and made everyone feel comfortable from the very beginning. He was self-depreciating and fun to talk to. He helped bring together the strangers and made it a fun experience that I would definitely do again.
Luis was a wonderful skipper. Our son had the opportunity to steer the boat and we shared story after story while watching the sun set. It's definitely chilly in November so dress warmly!

I had a great time on the sailing cruise! I was actually the only one on this experience (I think it is late in the season and it was a bit chilly!) but I enjoyed it! The sunset was beautiful and I'd definitely recommend it :)

The sea was absolutely beautiful with a fantastic view! It was so much fun to get out on the water. Sadly, it was a bit cold (we did it middle of November), but would still recommend. The trip was a little shorter than the three hours due to a fellow passenger stating they wouldn't mind going back early. Nonetheless, as someone who rarely sees the sea, much less one as beautiful as the Mediterranean, it was a fabulous experience I would suggest to a friend!
Adria was such a cool guide. He’s been sailing his whole life and had some unique perspectives- and a great playlist! He even had coats and blankets for us when it got cold.

We especially loved this experience! Our captain Adria made the experience special! Adria told us about he had been sailing since he was young and he was able to navigate the sailing on his own with ease. There was wine for us to drink and blankets for when it got chilly. Adria also had a great playlist. We took a million pictures!
This was a great experience! Adria was a wonderful skipper and I would highly recommend the sail as a unique activity and opportunity to see the city from a different view.

Sebastian was a wonderful host and was very attentive to his guests’ needs. I got sea sick unfortunately, but Sebastian was very kind and helpful; he went out of his to accommodate me, and I truly appreciated it. Nonetheless, it was a great experience and a beautiful way to view the city at sea. I would highly recommend it those exploring Barcelona!

Amazing experience with late afternoon departure from marina.
Watching sunset above Barcelona and night sailing back.
Night sailing gave special touch to this.
Thanks for making my birthday special!

A once-in-a-lifetime experience that we will never forget!!

It was just fantastic. We met at the meeting point and sailed right after.

Adrian our skipper was extremely friendly and explained everything we were interested in.

There were drinks the whole time and we really had an unforgettable experience we can only recommend it to anyone!!
A sensational experience, I recommend them to all sea lovers and those who are not, disconnection and enjoyment are assured
Sebastian was an excellent host, very friendly and let people experience driving a boat with his full confidence. Felt great and I appreciated that!
We had a great time on the boat cruise! Sebastian was an excellent host and was very attentive to all the passengers. Definitely recommend!
Pedro was fabulous, he made us feel extremely welcomed. Made sure we're all as comfortable as possible and he was so knowledgeable. It was great having him guide us.

We had an amazing time on our sailing endeavor! Luis was an expert and let a guest steer the ship almost the whole time. He made the whole experience very enjoyable and personable. He ended the trip by giving us some cava, which was delicious!! :)

Had a great time and was a special way to cap off an end to my trip to Barcelona. Sebastian was great. I went by myself and was happy to find a nice mix of couples, families and another solo traveler. The views were incredible!

Gorgeous sunset sailing with Sebastian! It was so nice! Sailing in good wind, taste for yourself (or not), laughing together, driving, marveling and enjoying a few snacks! The group was so nice, we made some new friends, wouldn't it have been so fresh, we would have all looked for staying at sea for even longer! Really nice!
Sebastian was really nice. He asked us if we wanna try maneuvering the boat, taking over sailing and stuff. Olives, wine and cava were served too. Thank you Sebastian
The four people listed as “hosts” were not there - instead we had Pedro, who was fantastic!! It was a perfect evening- fun, exciting, beautiful! I loved every second of it!
Great experience. Wonderful views ..and you get to try to sail yourself. It's overall really worth the money. But bring a jacket it gets really cold after the sunset.
This is a great experience and I would highly recommend it. Amazing sunset and Adria is a fantastic host! I would definitely book this again. Thanks!

Adria was an excellent host and clearly very knowledgeable and experienced. He was also very caring for the members of the trip who were seasick, while also sailing the boat singlehanded, serving food and teaching us about sailing! The experience made our stay in Barcelona - thanks Adrian! Would not hesitate to book again.

With there being multiple sailing tours available in Barcelona, we are incredible grateful that we chose the tour with Luis. Not only were the times optimal but he created a night we won't forget. The meeting location was easy to find and Luis told us about his background and his current careers including teaching the sailing school. His boat is gorgeous and he taught us about how to sail and the science behind how it works. The group was small (5 people) but it was perfect. We were able to learn about the lives of our fellow passengers as well as learn about Luis. We enjoyed the cava/wine/beer and snacks as well. Luis even allowed us the stay on the boat after the tour to continue to socialize which was unexpected and appreciated. Hopefully we can do one of his week-long sails in the future!!

My Friend Kim and I had a great time visiting Barcelona and this sailing trip was a wonderful highlight. We are from Indiana ( in the middle of the U.S. ..far from water) and sailing was on our bucket list of new experiences we wanted to try ( ok, maybe just me, Kim is a bit afraid of water). Before finally getting to go, We scheduled 3 sailing trips with other companies and each one was canceled by the host. We were so thrilled to find this one and couldn't have been happier with the experience. Interesting expert host and Interesting guests, Beautiful sunset and the opportunity to learn a little and help a little with the sailing.

Since it was late in the season, I ended up being the only person on this experience so I had a private cruise/sailing lesson! Sebastian was a great guide and teacher and I would highly recommend to anyone visiting for a relaxing evening on the water.

My husband and I had an amazing time our our sunset sailing trip with Sebastian! The views were incredible and learning about the sail boat was very interesting. We enjoyed some beer and cava on board, as well! :)
Sunset on a yacht with cava. Why resist? I had a solo tour by luck and Ramon was fab and we had some laughs! Recommend doing this experience!
It was the first sunset cruising. Barcelona seen from the sea was very nice. It was a sunset cruising in September, so the wind was very comfortable and not cold.

The sunset was really beautiful, so I’m glad we did it. Highlights were seeing some dolphins and jellyfish as we sailed along and the sunset on the return from the turnaround point. The bottle of sparkling wine and snacks for the guests were also nice touch. While we didn’t get to do any sailing and instead used the motor on the boat since the wind was weak, we moved at a good pace. I think I would have liked to learn a little about the sailing since we got back before we had planned, if something could be different. I liked that the captain Sebastian was very relaxed about the trip/boat and although we all spoke different languages we still got to understand each other.

Luis was amazing and despite not having adequate wind for really sailing we had a great time on the boat connecting, storytelling, drinking and swimming. One of the highlights of our trip to Barcelona.
Super fun trip. Drinks flow freely and he'll let you steer the ship. Really enjoyed it. One of the highlights of my Barcelona trip.
It was a really amazing experience! The group was very diverse, but we connected fast and had a lot of fun together. Adria was a super guide, explaining a lot of things.
A great trip. It was very nice. We were also allowed to sail something ourselves. It was a lot of fun. Everything worked and was well organized.

This was the best boat tour I've ever had!!! Your host, Luiz, speaks great English. He's very welcoming and has a good sense of humor. A person who knows what they're doing. The boat offered delicious olives, chips and beer unlimited)). And when the cruise ended, Luiz opened up a bottle of cold cava! The trip turned out to be super comfortable , the beauty of the sunset from the sea does not convey in words! And all this under Luis' hand-picked music!

Our sailing trip with Sebastian was wonderful. The sea was very restless that day, so unfortunately we could not go swimming. We had a great view of the skyline and sunset over Barcelona. It was a once in a lifetime experience!

My family and I just finished our sunset sailing cruise with Luis. The boat was beautiful and it was truly a wonderful night. Luis was the perfect host. So easy to talk to and so knowledgeable about this amazing city. I couldn't recommend him more. Thanks again.

Luis was accommodating before we got to do the experience. He was fully booked for the sunset cruise for the day we wanted. My friend had messaged him and he switched to a bigger boat, which was very kind of him!

The day of, we got a text 15min before the experience that someone else would be sailing with us. Which was mentioned in his profile that he has other people sail sometimes, fair. But, once we got there it was just a roll call then we hopped on the boat. There was no introduction to who he was or who the other guests were. It was very awkward at first because we weren’t sure what to do. The skipper didn’t tell us any stories, share anything about sailing if we wanted to take part, which we thought were part of the experience. We didn’t really converse with him. Only time was when I got seasick. He told me to get into the water then after I threw up he finally offered a seasickness pill. The boat ride was beautiful. The water was refreshing and the views were great. Sunset was amazing even while seasick haha. Just wish he would of explained about sailing and what were some of the views we were seeing. Also, there was only cava on board. There was no water, which I really needed because of the seasickness and I didn’t see any olives. It wasn’t as advertised. The sights were worth it, but I wish we had what was advertised when it came to what was being offered on this experience.
This was a great experience! If you're in Barcelona and want to combine a beautiful sunset with swimming in the open sea, go on an book it!
Great trip, good mix of sailing and being able to swim and enjoy the water. Beautiful way to see the city, especially at sunset. Highly recommended

It was really great, but the languages are not correct. I had booked her trip because he speaks German, unfortunately this was not the case. But it was still a great experience. We were allowed to jump into the open sea. Really great and unique.

Very good experience, I did not meet Luis but with a worker of him.
Which I thought was an excellent person, very friendly and very sociable

It was a once-in-a-lifetime experience.
Luis gave me his passion for the sea and the boats, taught me some essential “tricks” for sailing, was kind and involved all the participants.
Really great and highly recommended!

A fantastic sailing trip, great introduction from Luis, super friendly and likeable.
We could walk around anywhere on the boat and sat in front (best place)!
Lucky you, there were great waves and we had a lot of fun.
Luis offered drinks and snacks, thanks again for that.
I didn't want to leave at all, so don't think about it, but not this great evening
It was really nice to see Barcelona from the sea, especially with the sunset. I enjoyed sharing the sailing experience with my family. Our skipper, Jordi was friendly and attentive. Recommended!

The trip was a beautiful and unique experience: Barcelona before the setting sun! In addition, our skipper Jeroni was very friendly and accommodating. There were drinks (water and cava) and chips as well as olives for meals. We had relatively little conversation with the other guests (a group of three). It was very relaxing to just be able to enjoy the view.

A wonderful sail in Barcelona! My brother booked this evening on the water, and I went with him, my sister-in-law and nephew. Adria was with us on the boat and was just exceptional. He knew his stuff and, since my brother and nephew are both experienced sailors, he let them do their thing. The three of them made a terrific team! In addition to a great sail, we had fascinating conversations. All in all, a lovely evening. What a great idea. Bravo to Luis and his team!

I'll start out by saying that Luis runs a sailing school out of the Olympic Marina in Barcelona. We met Luis when we arrived and he had a very professional sail trainer named Adria as our host. I'll start out by saying that my son and I are sailors from Long Island NY so we handled the boat most of the time. We had a fantastic sail on a Bavaria 38' yacht that was the smallest available that night but we chose it because it fit our style. It was a good handling yacht, perfect for learning or if you are an experiyencd sailor.

The view of the Barcelona skyline and the distant mountains was spectacular with the sun setting behind. We were served olives tortilla chips and Cava and we brought along our own food too.

This was the first time I've ever used an Airbnb"experience" and it was perfect. Thanks Luis and Adria for a fantastic time.
My group thoroughly enjoyed our sailing trip. Luis is very professional, yet friendly. He is an expert in his craft and an accommodating host.

Luis was very knowledgeable, accommodating, and friendly. About halfway through our trip, it started to rain and thunderstorm, and we had to turn back to shore. This cut our boat ride short, but as soon as we docked, Luis ran to the nearby store and bought two more bottles of Cava and some more snacks so that we could stay on board and continue to have fun.

We, a group of American tourists, were on board with a group of three British-Chinese women, and Luis created a fun space for us to get to know each other well and have a great time chatting. The atmosphere on the boat was really fun even though the weather outside wasn't so great.

Thanks, Luis!
Luis is great, if you want a wonderful boat trip experience, go with Luis without a second thought. He is very sensible, caring and generous. We all loved Luis!
Awesome! This is a must do if you have the opportunity in Barcelona. The trip was spectacular and a great experience that was very fairly priced.
This was a great experience. We had a wonderful ride with a good group of people with a wonderful sunset. Would definitely recommend!

This was a great experience in Barcelona! Was so amazing to watch the sunset in a beautiful location. Luis was very knowledgable about sailing and was a great host - he was so friendly and helpful 😀. So glad that we done this and would definitely recommend others to book!

We had a fantastic time with Luis. He’s really an expert in his field and comes with a host of life, work, and travel experiences. Truly a great guy to talk to, and he fosters a very close and connected feeling among your fellow passengers. I think trying this out is a must. 👍🏼
This sailing trip was the highlight of my visit to Barcelona. Luis is such a great guy and just seeing the city from the water was extremely beautiful. Now, I want to learn how to sail!
This was lovely! Our skipper, Jerome, was most hospitable and answered a lot of questions I had about Catalonia. The water is perfect for a dip and he served us cava.

We had the most awesome Sunset Cruise with Luis’s assistant Astexta ( or something like that). He was
Very experienced and took photos. Highlight was swimming in the wonderful Mediterranean Sea and sipping cava after a nice swim! Definitely recommend!

Ending my Barcelona trip with a sailing experience was a great choice. The sea and the sunset was a perfect way to see the city from a different angle.

Luis makes us do a bit of the holding the rope stuff, steering, etc. It makes us felt like "we know what we are doing" but in reality, I understand how much knowledge it goes into the sailing part and it isn't easy. lol

The sad part about sailing is someone always somehow gets seasick. We can't do much about it, Kuddo to how Luis handled the girls who sadly made a mess on the deck. I thought he handle it well, he cleaned it up immediately and it was fine.

Overall I give a lot of respect and thoroughly enjoyed my trip with Luis, so much that I have to recommend my friend who is coming to Barcelona in two weeks to visit him again. :)




Thank you!
Luis was an exceptional host and very friendly. The ride was very nice and he taught us some sailing basics along the way. Highly recommend!

Luis is an excellent skipper combined with a very good host who takes very good care of his guests. The sailing was just great and Luis explained a lot about winds and steering. The vista of Barcelona from the sea is marvelous. I recommend booking with Luis! You will love it!
I had a great time there was just a little bit of a language barrier but we worked it out in the end and could all understand each other. It was a great experience and I would definitely do it again.

The experience was absolutely great! Luis is very nice, professional and friendly. Though we didn't have much wind and had to use mostly motor instead of sails it was fantastic anyways. Luis told us many interesting stories and managed to make all the guests feel like a close group of friends. There were Cava, wine and other drinks. The boat is beautiful, cozy and tidy. We enjoyed the sunset as promised :) Also Luis gave some great recommendation on restaurants! I would not only come back for such trip again but happily join Luis for his studying program on sails boats!

Book it! 100% worth it. Very romantic, even in a shared setting with other guests. The sunset over the skyline and the church way up on the hill was incredible. Truly was a once in a lifetime experience.

I had a great time sailing. My captain that day was actually Sebastian. He was a friendly guy who has been sailing since he was a child. The drinks and snacks were not all that special, just some wine and chips; but I met some great people from all over and enjoyed my conversation with them.

Luis was unavailable for our trip (we were informed in advance), so Sebastian was our captain. He was very friendly and his sailing knowledge was very apparent. It was interesting hearing his stories and discovering he started sailing at 6 years old in his native country of Argentina. On the boat, we were offered locally sourced white wine and cava, as well as olives and crisps. If you’re booking this trip, make sure you sit at the front of the boat, as you get a full view of the sunset and sky over Barcelona!

At the end of the trip, we exchanged details with a couple of people we got to know on the trip and have kept in touch.

Wonderful sunset cruise with gorgeous views of beaches and skyline of Barcelona! Fun to go with others and had fun sailing the boat! Had a spectacular moonrise as the cruise was coming to an end. Highly recommend 👏🏼

Great experience and great value for money. We caught some incredible sunset views and great views of the city from the water. Our captain was great, made us feel welcome and even helped us with a last minute change of schedule
This experience was amazing, we had a 3-hour sailing around Barcelona, and could see an unique sunset from the sea. We learnt things about sailing and it was very interesting. I highly recommend it !

It was a very beautiful experience. Luis is experienced and involved with those present and explains a lot of things. True to the description. A nice moment of disconnection outside the city. Thank you Luis !
My daughter and I loved the sunset sailing cruise. Luis let my daughter participate in the sailing experience which she loved. I would highly recommend it to all of our family and friends.
Super fun relaxing trip with great people! Louis sure knows how create an enjoyable atmosphere- fun times and pleasant experience! A must in Barcelona

Thank you Louis,
Sybil and I had a most fabulous evening on your sailboat. We will definitely recommend to our friends and family!

Luis was awesome. I've been on plenty of boat rides in various parts of the world, but I appreciated how personalized this experience was. There were six other attendees, and we got to learn about how a sailboat works as opposed to just sitting and watching. He also provided several thoughtful touches - snacks, drinks, and blankets. I even got to steer for a bit, which was really fun. Barcelona is beautiful at sunset, and the view from the water is just something else.

Luis is a pretty interesting guy who has lived in both the US and Europe, and is able to relate to people of various backgrounds well. I would definitely recommend this activity.

Lovely way to spend an evening. Probably the best view of a sunset you will get in Barcelona! Luis is clearly very passionate and knowledgeable about sailing. Thanks for sharing your boat. Good luck with the next one!

Thank you so much for a lovely evening Luis. Very insightful and a chilled, fun experience. We got to hear plenty of sailing stories and we got to steer the boat ourselves! Luis was very accommodating and had plenty of delightful snacks for us. Will do again next time we’re here - on the new boat Luis is getting soon!

Luis knows what he's doing. We were a larger group with 5 people, especially my brother was pleased to hear about radar and driving regulations, control and learning to "feel the wind". It was a lot of fun for everyone, even if my stomach was a bit lazy. But we are not all equally water friendly. :)

This experience was beyond amazing! Luis was so knowledgeable, and the boat itself felt safe and was very well equipped. My friend and I felt our trip to Barcelona was better because of this tour, and we would recommend it to anyone we know.

A fantastic experience with a very knowledgeable and equally friendly Luis. He made us feel at home and treated like family. Great communication style and hospitality. Amazingly witty. Highly recommend this experience to anyone.

Luis is AWESOME. The boat ride was a great experience. First, Luis speaks several languages fluently so he gracefully shifted between speaking German, English and Spanish which generated comfort and camaraderie in the group (I am a native English speaker The group included native English speakers, native Spanish speakers, native Italian speakers who spike German,
Second, within 30 minutes on the boat I got seasick and threw up all over - Luis was caring, kind, and handled the situation in a way that minimized my shame and embarrassment. I was soon smiling again and enjoyed the rest of the ride. I would definitely recommend it and will do it again.

Luis is a very friendly and communicative skipper. He controls his boat and lets in some inexperienced guests. It's clear they have everything under control and are able to intervene in an emergency. It was a lot of fun.

An extraordinary experience with a "attentive" host! Not only is Luis fluffy and speaks German, French, English, and Spanish perfectly (I hope I don't forget one!) but he also knows how to make guests feel at ease. We were able to keep the bar ourselves for almost all of the experience under the control of Luis, who guided us through the adventure. In the end, we had a splendid sunset, the dream!

In short: an extraordinary activity in a fabulous setting and surrounded by an exceptional host!

Thank you Luis for this wonderful getaway aboard your sumptuous sailboat.
It was a great experience. We had a lot of fun. If you want you can try to sail yourself. Thank you so much, muchos gracias, vielen Dank :)

This was an amazing experience. Although we didn’t have ideal weather for sailing, we made the best of it. My wife and I went together, and were mixed together with a small group. There were 6 people total so it was very nice and intimate and you didn’t feel like you were just one out of 50 people in the crowd. Luis actually let us help with the sailing and was very knowledgeable and a good teacher. He actually teaches people to sail as well as doing the tours, so he knows how to teach. Overall, I had a great experience and would highly recommend it.

Luis is super friendly and thoughtful host. His English is great, he willingly shares stories and perspective. The trip is perfect either you want to just sit, chill and enjoy cava or roam around the boat and participate in sailing.

What a great evening on the water with Luis, our captain, and my 5 travel companions! The weather was a little chilly but the warmth of our host set the tone for a unique experience. Luis is a great guest, he speaks several languages and knows how to make guests feel at ease by distilling some anecdotes from his crust to make us smile, and detailed information about places and buildings to discover. He knows his estate thoroughly and you feel safe on his boat. I highly recommend the tour to see Barcelona from a different perspective and let yourself be stuck by the current!

Its a very precious experience! I really really enjoyed that! I will never forget this sailing experience! Luis is a sooooo nice person! He has tons of knowledge of sailing, very professional! And he is very nice with people! Very good communication! We have a wonderful talk on sailing! I hope I can go back in the future!!

Really welcoming people! Because it's my first time on this boat! Then it's the dizziness!He was really super nice. I vomited and took care of me and left me a bottle of champagne because I didn't drink it on the boat!Really! Too man and I booked the project by myself today! The boat is on! I'm really touched.

We did this sailing trip for my 40th birthday. It was an incredible experience. I wanted to sail so long and finally I could make it come true. Luise was a complete skipper and gave us all the basics! From the beginning, we could participate, so I should control the whole time, for example. It was pure adrenaline and we will rave about this experience for a long time😍🤗!!!
Thank you very much Luis
We had a great time even though we unfortunately didn’t see the sunset!
The sailing experience was wonderful!! Luis thought of every detail and the whole evening was absolutely perfect!
The experience is great for anyone visiting Barcelona for the first time. I definitely recommend to anyone especially during sunset hours! 11.5/10
A must do!
Great experience! And our captain Luis made everything so we enjoyed it a lot.
Very nice experience. Sunset was gorgeous. Our captain Xavy was great and experienced. Highly recommend!
Sailing with Luis was great. He was polite and attentive. Sunset was beautiful.
Top !
Gorgeous sunset sailing trip!
Great trip we all had a great time. Luis was very knowledgeable and a great host
Nice trip with Gabriel! Pleasant guy!
